TRAFFIC ADVISORY
In connection with BIBI-KA-ALAM procession from Bibi-ka-Alawa, Hyderabad, the following traffic restrictions/diversions will be made on            06-07-2025 from 12.00 PM to 10.00 PM.
1. The Vehicular traffic will not be allowed towards BiBi-ka-Alawa at Sunargalli ‘T’ Junction and it will be diverted towards Dabeerpura Darwaza and Ganga Nagar Nala, Yakutpura side.
2. The Vehicular traffic will not be allowed towards Shaik Faiz Kaman and it will be diverted at Jabbar Hotel towards Dabeerpura Darwaza or Chanchalguda as per the need.
3. The Vehicular traffic coming from Ethebar Chowk will not be allowed towards Bada Bazar and it will be diverted at Ethebar Chowk towards either Kotla Alija or Purana Haveli side as per the need/situation.
4. When the main procession reaches Ganga Nagar Nala, Yakutpura, the traffic coming from Purani Haveli will not be allowed towards Etebar Chowk and it will be diverted at Purani Haveli towards either Chatta bazar, Dabeerpura or SJ Rotary.
5. When the procession reaches Ganga Nagar Nala, the traffic coming from Moghalpura and Volta hotel will not be allowed towards Etebar Chowk and it will be diverted at Bibi Bazar X roads towards Paris café or Talab katta side as per the situation.
6. When the procession reaches Etebar Chowk, the traffic coming from Mitti-ka-sher and Madina will not be allowed towards Etebar Chowk and it will be diverted at Gulzar House towards Madina or Mitti-ka-sher.
7. When the procession reaches Kotla Alija, the traffic coming from Moghalpura water tank will not be allowed towards Chowk Maidan Khan and it will be diverted at Hafez Danka Mosque towards Paris Cafe or Bibi Bazar side as per the need.
8. When the procession reaches Charminar, the traffic coming from Shakkerkote will not be allowed towards Gulzar House and it will be diverted at Mitti-Ka-Sher Junction towards either Ghansi Bazar or Chelapura, whereas the traffic at Ethebar Chowk will be diverted towards Kotla Alija or Purani Haveli.
9. When the procession reaches Charminar, the traffic coming from Nayapool will not be allowed towards Charminar and it will be diverted at Madina X Road towards the City College.
Cont…2
::  2  ::
10. When the procession reaches Miralam Mandi, the traffic coming from Chaderghat Rotary, Noorkhan Bazar, Salarjung Museum and Shivaji Bridge will not be  allowed towards Purani Haveli and it will be diverted at Salarjung Rotary  towards Nayapool, Shivaji Bridge and Noorkhan bazar sides.
11.  When the procession reaches Alawa Sartauq, the traffic coming from Chaderghat  Rotary will not be allowed towards Kali Khabar and it will be diverted at  Chaderghat Rotary towards Ranga Mahal or Koti via Chaderghat bridge.
12. Traffic coming from Gowliguda or Afzalgunj will not be allowed towards Salar Jung/ Shivaji Bridge and it will be diverted towards Afzal Gunj and Gowliguda sides at the entrance of Salar Jung/Shivaji Bridge on Gowliguda side.
13. When the procession reaches Alwa Sartauq the traffic will not be allowed towards SJ Rotary and it will be diverted at Nayapool towards Madina,
14. The APSRTC/TGSRTC district buses will be diverted towards Rang Mahal and Afzalgunj sides for entry and exit from 10.00 AM to 9.00 PM on 06-07-2025 and they will be allowed to come on Kalikabar and Miralam Mandi road till the procession reaches the destination.
The following restrictions on vehicular traffic will also be imposed  from 4.00 PM to 8.30 PM on 06-07-2025 in Secunderabad area.
1. The vehicular traffic proceeding from Tankbund towards Karbala Maidan will be diverted at Children's Park towards Kavadiguda, Bible House and R.P.Road.
2. The vehicular traffic proceeding from the R.P.Road towards Karbala Maidan will be diverted at the Traffic Island near Bible House (via) Kavadiguda X roads and will join the Tankbund Road at DBR Mills "T" Junction.
3. Mahatma Gandhi Road between the Central Telegraph Island and Ranigunj will be "ONE WAY” towards Ranigunj side. The Traffic will be diverted at Ranigunj Junction towards the Ministers Road (KIMS Hospital) on need basis.
The commuters are requested to take alternative routes to reach their destinations to avoid traffic congestion. In case of any emergency during travel, the commuters are requested to call our traffic help line 9010203626 for travel assistance and to follow traffic updates on our social media platform@Hyderabad Traffic Police face book page (https://t.co/RMgFu4rSW3), @HYDP (Twitter handle) and cooperate with the Hyderabad Traffic Police.
Jt. Commissioner of Police,
Traffic, Hyderabad City.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 05 July 2025(Saturday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales(Olongapo, San Antonio, Castillejos, Subic, San Marcelino).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Cavite, Tarlac, Metro Manila, Rizal and Nueva Ecija within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bulacan(Hagonoy, Paombong, Malolos, Calumpit), Zambales(Iba, Palauig) and Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Masantol) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZISbP.

The Philippines continues to lag behind many Asian countries in healthcare due to a combination of systemic, economic, and geographic challenges. 

Here’s a comprehensive breakdown of the reasons, especially in contrast to top-performing Asian nations:

🇵🇭 Why the Philippines Lags in Healthcare

1. 🏚️ Underfunded Public Health System

• The Philippines spends less on healthcare as a percentage of GDP than many of its Southeast Asian neighbors 

• This results in:

Fewer hospitals and clinics

• Outdated equipment
• Limited access to essential medicines

2. 👩‍⚕️ Severe Shortage of Healthcare Workers

• The country has only 1 doctor per 25,300 people, far below the WHO recommendation of 1:1,000 

• Many Filipino doctors and nurses migrate abroad for better pay, leaving rural areas underserved.

3. 🏝️ Geographic Fragmentation

• With over 7,600 islands, the Philippines faces logistical challenges in delivering healthcare to remote and rural communities 

• Transportation barriers and lack of infrastructure make emergency and routine care difficult to access.

4. 💸 High Out-of-Pocket Costs

• Many Filipinos rely on out-of-pocket payments for medical care, which discourages early treatment and preventive care.
• Public dissatisfaction with healthcare remains low—only 29% expressed satisfaction in 2021, compared to 82% in Singapore 

5. 📉 Weak Preventive Health Programs

• The system is heavily skewed toward curative care, with insufficient investment in:• Health education
• Vaccination programs
• Community-based disease prevention

6. 🦠 Burden of Non-Communicable and Infectious Diseases

• The Philippines faces a double burden:

High rates of heart disease, diabetes, and cancer
• Persistent threats from dengue, tuberculosis, and respiratory infections 

🌏 How Asia Compares

CountryHealth Care Index (2025)Key Strengths

Taiwan87.0

Universal NHI, tech-driven, low cost

South Korea82.8

Advanced hospitals, high doctor-patient ratio
Japan80.2

Aging population care, preventive health culture
Thailand77.3

Strong public health system, medical tourism
Philippines66.8

Underfunded, fragmented, workforce shortages 

🧭 Path Forward for the Philippines

To catch up with its Asian neighbors, the Philippines must:

• Increase public health investment, especially in rural areas
• Retain and incentivize healthcare workers
• Strengthen PhilHealth and ensure universal coverage
• Modernize infrastructure and expand telemedicine
• Prioritize preventive care and health literacy
